item.title: Traffic lught timing issues, 8th August
item.description:
A number of times recently I've emerged from gchq direction towards gloucester straight.over and cars are pulling out from park and ride direction and I suspect the traffic light timings are off and not allow the red lights to come on or green is coming on too soon from park and ride direction and has happened a few times I suspect traffic light timing issue. When I'm going through on green car are pulling out and I suspect this could cause accidents. It could be I've just been unlucky a few times with cars jumping lights but it's happened too many times for me not to think it's a timing issue with the lights and ones in green and another has turned green to quick..
